title: SQLite before 3.54.0 built with FTS5 contains a heap buffer overflow in fts5DoSecureDelete() that allows attackers to…
description: SQLite versions before 3.54.0 built with the FTS5 extension contain a heap buffer overflow vulnerability in the fts5DoSecureDelete() function. This flaw allows attackers to write beyond the allocated leaf page buffer by supplying a crafted database file with a corrupted FTS5 index. When secure-delete is enabled and the corrupted index is deleted, heap memory corruption and application crashes can occur.
